items.label: Minimal
items.text:
Paragraphs should be Minimal: One to two sentences of narration per paragraph. Frequent paragraph breaks; heavy white space. 
Dialogues are unaffected and don't count as sentences.

items.label: Light
items.text:
Paragraphs should be Light: One to three sentences of narration per paragraph. Breaks come often.
Dialogues are unaffected and don't count as sentences.

items.label: Standard
items.text:
Paragraphs should be Standard: one to five sentences of narration per paragraph. Conventional novel paragraphing; a paragraph holds one beat and closes. 
Dialogues are unaffected and don't count as sentences.

items.label: Full
items.text:
Paragraphs should be Full: one to eight sentences per paragraph. Paragraphs accumulate detail before breaking; a single block can carry an entire action or observation sequence. 
Dialogues are unaffected and don't count as sentences.

items.label: Dense
items.text:
Paragraphs should be Dense: Eight or more sentences of narration per paragraph. Breaks occur only at hard shifts in subject or scene; description, action, and interiority together. 
Dialogues are unaffected and don't count as sentences.

items.label: Adaptive Density
items.text:
Paragraphs should be Adaptive: Determine required number of sentences of narration needed per paragraph for scene. Use as much it the scene demands. Developmental and transitional scenes should have 1-5 sentences, reactive should have 1-2, climax can be 1-8. 
Dialogues are unaffected and don't count as sentences.
